points.description: Names Replication as one mode of control plane (physical) distribution.
States a correct downside of replication: scalability issue, higher resources/cost, wasted standby resources with no load distribution, or hard/complex data consistency between replicas.
Names Partitioning as the other mode of control plane (physical) distribution.
States a correct downside of partitioning: issues like P2P networks, need for knowledge of neighborhood, coordination and consistency problems, or lower availability.

rubric.notes: Each mode must be named with the exact term (replication, partitioning) and paired with its own correct downside from the model answer. A downside given without the mode named, or attached to the wrong mode, earns nothing for that point. Vague drawbacks (e.g. "it is complex" or "costly" with no link to the mode) earn nothing; a wrong extra claim cancels that point. No part marks are needed beyond the quarter-mark steps.
